text: Continuous integration is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared project. Every time someone makes a change, automated builds start immediately. These builds compile the code and run tests without any manual work. The main goal is catching issues early, before they become serious problems. If a test fails, the team knows right away and can fix it quickly. CI pipelines make this process smooth by organising each step, from building to testing and reporting results. This saves time and helps teams work with more confidence.
